top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Notification Requirements - Notify Licensing in Writing Within 15 Days of Changing Location or Address (26 TAC §742.401(f)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver put in writing that she has a new address.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered (26 TAC §HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not R)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were 5 unrelated children found in care at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Prominent & Public (26 TAC §746.403(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The parent board is displayed in the director's office, making it difficult for employees and parents to view.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A reviewed child's file did not have the completed water activity permission.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Exception or Exemption on File and Verified (26 TAC §746.613(c)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child did not have a complete affidavit for their immunization exemption. The form was signed, dated, and notarized but did not indicate which immunizations he would no longer be receiving.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.
